learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn that everything around us has a name, and these names are called Naming Words or Nouns.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Look around your room! 👀 What do you see? A bed, a toy, mummy, or a dog? Everything has a name! Let's learn about these magical Naming Words.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🏷️ What are Naming Words? (नाम वाले शब्द)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Naming Word is the name of a Person, Place, Animal, or Thing. In grammar, we also call them Nouns (संज्ञा). If you can see it and name it, it's a noun!
Everyone you know has a name or a title. These are naming words for people.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🦁 Names of Animals & Birds (जानवरों और पक्षियों के नाम)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: All our furry and feathery friends have names too! These are naming words for animals and birds.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🏡 Names of Places & Things (स्थान और वस्तुओं के नाम)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Where do you go? Places! What do you play with? Things! Their names are also Naming Words.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of these is a name of a Thing?
❓ 'Doctor' is a naming word for a...

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Look at the picture of a classroom. Write any 2 naming words you can think of.
subjective_practice.hint: What do you sit on? What does the teacher write on?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Underline the naming word in this sentence: 'The cat is sleeping.'
subjective_practice.hint: Who is sleeping? Find the animal name.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with a naming word: I love to eat an ______.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 Noun Hunt Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Walk around your house and collect 3 items. Tell your parents their names. Congratulations, you just found 3 Naming Words (Things)!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Naming Words are names of Persons, Places, Animals, or Things.
⭐ Naming words are also called Nouns.
